snippet.title: Evil Inside VR - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
#playstation #psvr2 
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10016851
  
Evil Inside VR is not just a simple adaptation to Virtual Reality. It’s a complete reimagining of the original story, rebuilt to deliver a new, deeper, and more terrifying psychological horror experience. With significant changes in gameplay, lighting, sound, and puzzle design, this version completely transforms the way you experience Mark’s nightmare.

After the death of his mother and the arrest of his father, Mark tries to contact her through a Ouija board. But something goes wrong… and his descent into the unknown begins. Now, you will live that story from the inside, with all your senses consumed by fear.

Explore a house designed to make you feel trapped in a hostile, shifting, and tension-filled environment. Rebuilt puzzles, more realistic lighting, immersive spatial sound, and a renewed narrative flow will make you experience horror like never before.

Key Features:

- More than just an adaptation: Entire sections have been redesigned and new elements introduced to offer a fully unique and renewed experience—even for those who played the original.
- Full VR support: Play standing or seated, with total, natural, and precise interaction.
- Improved lighting and sound: A darker and more realistic atmosphere paired with an immersive, disturbing soundscape.
- Redesigned puzzles: Built from scratch for full interaction and tailored to true VR gameplay.
- Truly immersive horror: Fear is not just seen or heard—it’s felt.

This is not the same Evil Inside you remember. It’s a new nightmare.

©2025 JanduSoft & Bowl of Tentacles
